# Third-party license bundle staging area

This directory is the staged license-text area for the sealed AgentGuard RC.
It contains exact source-derived text for the six native libraries resolved in
the final factual gate. The exact component mappings, source RPM hashes, and
RC file hashes are in `artifacts/psycopg-binary-native-evidence.json`; the
deterministic broader plan is in `artifacts/license-source-bundle-plan.json`.

The complete 120-component release bundle is not yet assembled. Before
distribution, add authoritative exact-version LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE,
copyright, AUTHORS, and applicable source artifacts from the recorded official
upstream, Debian, or CentOS sources. A URL alone is not treated as a completed
bundle. Preserve exact upstream wording and retain file-scoped attributions;
do not infer or rewrite legal terms.
